requirements.title: Model Management
requirements.description: CLI + Settings UI list/search/install/enable/disable/remove models with size, hardware-fit, license, capability labels; checksummed opt-in downloads; disk-space awareness; custom/fine-tuned local entries.

validation.notes: Install verifies checksum and disk space; in-use weights refuse install/remove through the shared model-use gate
AI inference holds the model-use lease across all requested variations and releases it before NSFW auto-scan
Standalone NSFW sidecar retains the model-use lease for the complete inference call
RemoveModel reports FailedPrecondition and preserves installed weights while the model is in use
Enable/disable/remove and custom local-model entry round-trip
Settings UI manages models with hardware-fit indicators
